why: S1 (5b0ecb3 against 61621bb) moves the generic half of imitation/artifacts.py, RowCodec and the probe statistics out of imitation/ with IL still in-tree. An IL run (legacy config shape, init at half the seeded actor, a snapshot reference at lambda != 0, a freeze for one iteration) must be identical on every column except the commit: weights, moments, state digests, every imitation/* metric, the alarm firings and the checkpoint's optimizers/misc.json included.
